answer: Require high-value actions to pass a dispersed witness quorum: at least three independent witnesses in different regions, with no shared stake, must attest within a short window. Like a ridge crossed only by separate paths, one operator cannot fake the quorum from a single room. At the nadir of trust, a new identity needs more witnesses; with a clean record, the quorum shrinks. A zephyr of small, cheap checks fills gaps between big actions, so keeping many fake identities means paying separate, unrelated witnesses for each one, scaling cost linearly and breaking Sybil economics.
